info.title: BusinessSAAS API
info.description:
## BusinessSAAS — Multi-tenant Business Operating System

Modular SaaS platform: CRM, RBAC, Tasks, and more. All endpoints live under `/api/v1`.

### Authentication
Protected endpoints require `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`.
Obtain via `POST /auth/login`; renew via `POST /auth/refresh` (cookie-based, transparent).

### Tenant isolation
Every org-scoped endpoint validates `:orgId` against `business_id` in the JWT. Cross-org access is blocked at middleware.

### Error envelope
```json
{ "success": false, "error": { "code": "...", "message": "..." }, "request_id": "..." }
```
Use `code` in frontend switch statements.

### Permissions
Dot-notation keys: `resource.action` or `module.resource.action`. Effective set = role + custom - denied.

code.description: Machine-readable error code. Use in frontend switch statements.

email.description: Normalized to lowercase. Must be globally unique.

access_token.description: Short-lived JWT. Attach as: Authorization: Bearer <token>

issueTokens.description: If true, issues access token + sets refresh cookie

slug.description: Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens only. Globally unique.

key.description: Dot-notation key used in middleware and frontend gates.

permissions.description: Effective permission keys. Use for frontend permission gates.

deniedPermissions.description: Explicit revocations, even if the role grants them.

assignedTo.description: User UUID, public UUID, or email. Must be active org member.

UpdateTaskRequest.description: All fields optional. Set assignedTo='' to unassign. Set dueDate='' to clear.

dueDate.description: RFC3339 or empty string to clear

assignedTo.description: User ID/email or empty string to unassign

stage_ids.description: All stage IDs in desired order. All existing IDs must be present.

stage_id.description: Target stage UUID. Must belong to the deal's pipeline.
